features.label: Wrote himself out of it
features.detail: Never speaks in his own voice. Every idea is in someone else's mouth, which makes pinning him down deliberately hard.

features.label: Distrusted democracy
features.detail: Watched Athens execute his teacher by vote. His politics never recovered and should not be read as neutral.

features.label: The argument is the point
features.detail: Dialogues that end unresolved on purpose. Reading for conclusions misses the entire method.
